Chapter IV · Developer profile

Ashtrom Residences

Ashtrom Residences, formerly Ashdar, is the wholly owned residential development arm of the TASE-listed Ashtrom Group.

At a glance

Parent group
Ashtrom Group (wholly owned)
Listed on TASE
Via parent Ashtrom Group
Former name
Ashdar
Experience
40+ years in residential development
CEO
Arnon Friedman (since 2008)
Official website (opens in a new tab)

Ashtrom Residences is the homebuilding subsidiary of Ashtrom Group, one of Israel's largest construction and real estate groups, whose shares trade on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The company operated for decades as Ashdar before being rebranded under the parent group's name, and it reports more than 40 years of experience planning and building residential projects. It is led by CEO Arnon Friedman.

Its activity spans standard new-build projects, combination deals with landowners and a large urban renewal programme covering both pinui-binui and NOP 38 schemes in major cities. In Netanya the company is developing Galei Netanya in the Park HaYam district, a two-tower project designed by Mann-Shinar Architects close to the beach and a green park. Elsewhere in central Israel it is active in Tel Aviv-Jaffa, Ramat HaSharon and Givat Shmuel, among other cities, often working with external architecture firms on each scheme.

Key areas of activity

  • New-build residential projects
  • Urban renewal (pinui-binui and NOP 38)
  • Combination transactions with landowners
  • Central Israel and major cities nationwide
